name: Malt-O-Meal Original Quick Hot Wheat Cereal (Farina)
whyItWorks: Finely milled enriched wheat farina with all coarse bran removed. Cooks in 3 minutes into a velvety, silky smooth porridge that coats the stomach without friction. Delivers 60% daily value of bioavailable iron to replenish anemia.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Whisk 3 tbsp into 1 cup boiling water or almond milk. Simmer on low for 3 minutes, stirring constantly. Top with brown sugar or maple syrup.
